book.name: Fes Kranakuls
book.title: Fes Kranakuls Ola Stori Blanga King Deibid

content: Wal dijan na detlot neim blanga ola lida brom ola Isreil femili, en detlot boswan brom detlot klen, en detlot wekinmen weya deibin oldei lukaftumbat Isreil. Wal ebri manth difrin grup garram 24,000 wekinmen bin oldei wek garram difrinwan bos.

Wal dislot na bin detlot boswan blanga ebri difrinwan manth. Wal Jeishabim bin jidan bos langa det feswan manth. Imbin det san blanga Seibdiyel, en imbin brom det femili lain blanga Peres, en blanga det Juda klen. Dodai bin jidan bos langa det namba 2 manth. Imbin brom det femili lain blanga Ahohi. Mikloth bin det sekanwan bos. Benaiya bin jidan bos langa det namba 3 manth. Imbin det san blanga Jehoiyada det serramonimen. Imbin lida blanga Detlot 30 Solja. Im san Amisabad bin teikoba brom im dedi en jidan det boswan lida blanga det grup na. Esahel bin jidan bos langa det namba 4 manth. Imbin det braja blanga Jowab. Im san neim bin Sebadaiya en bin teikoba brom im dedi. Shamuth bin jidan bos langa det namba 5 manth. Imbin brom det femili lain blanga Isa. Aira bin jidan bos langa det namba 6 manth. Imbin det san blanga Aikesh brom det kantri gulum Tekowa. Heles bin jidan bos langa det namba 7 manth. Imbin brom det taun gulum Pelon langa det kantri blanga det Ifreiyim klen. Sibakai bin jidan bos langa det namba 8 manth. Imbin brom det kantri gulum Husha blanga det femili blanga Sara en blanga det Juda klen. Abaiyesa bin jidan bos langa det namba 9 manth. Imbin brom det kantri gulum Einathoth blanga det Benjamin klen. Maharai bin jidan bos langa det namba 10 manth. Imbin brom det kantri gulum Netofa blanga det femili gulum Sera. Benaiya bin jidan bos langa det namba 11 manth. Imbin brom det taun gulum Pairathan langa det kantri blanga det Ifreiyim klen. Heldai bin jidan bos langa det namba 12 manth. Imbin brom det kantri gulum Netofa en imbin brom det femili lain blanga Othniyel.
Detlot men hubin lukaftumbat detlot klen blanga Isreil

Wal dijan na detlot neim blanga ol detlot men hubin lukaftumbat detlot klen blanga Isreil. Eliyeisa det san blanga Sikri bin boswan lida blanga det Rubin klen. Shefataiya det san blanga Meiyaka bin boswan lida blanga det Simiyan klen. Hashabaiya det san blanga Kemyuwel bin boswan lida blanga det Libai klen. Seidok bin boswan lida blanga det Eran femili. Ilaihu bin wanbala braja blanga King Deibid. Imbin boswan lida blanga det Juda klen. Omri det san blanga Maikul bin boswan lida blanga det Isaka klen. Ishmaiya det san blanga Obadaiya bin boswan lida blanga det Sebyulan klen. Jeramath det san blanga Esriyel bin boswan lida blanga det Neftali klen. Hosheiya det san blanga Esasaiya bin boswan lida blanga det Ifreiyim klen. Jowal det san blanga Pedaiya bin boswan lida blanga det Sangodanwei Manesa klen. Ido det san blanga Sekaraiya bin boswan lida blanga det Sanraiswei Manesa klen. Jasiyel det san blanga Ebna bin boswan lida blanga det Benjamin klen. Esarel det san blanga Jeroham bin boswan lida blanga det Den klen.

Wal King Deibid nomo bin pudumdan det namba blanga detlot pipul hubin anda 20 yiya ol, dumaji YAWEI det trubala God bin pramis blanga meigim det namba blanga detlot Isreil pipul bigiswan jis laik detlot sta langa top.

Bat Jowab hu mami bin Seruwaiya, imbin stat kaundimap detlot pipul bat im nomo bin binij dumaji YAWEI bin panishim detlot Isreil pipul. En blanga tharran na olabat nomo bin pudumdan det namba langa det speshalwan buk blanga King Deibid.
Detlot men hubin lukaftumbat ola kantri blanga det king

Wal dijan na detlot neim blanga ol detlot boswan hubin lukaftumbat ola ebrijing blanga det king. Esmabeth det san blanga Ediyel bin lukaftumbat detlot stowa rum blanga det king langa Jerusalem. Jonathan det san blanga Yusaiya bin lukaftumbat najalot stowa rum. Esrai det san blanga Kelab bin lukaftumbat detlot wekinmen blanga detlot fam. Shimiyai brom det pleis gulum Rema bin lukaftumbat detlot greip tri. Seibdai im brom det pleis gulum Shefam bin lukaftumbat detlot wain. Beilenan brom det pleis gulum Geda bin lukaftumbat detlot olibtri en najalot tri weya deibin growap sangodansaid langa detlot hil. Jowesh bin lukaftumbat ola oliboil langa det stowa rum. Shitai bin brom det pleis gulum Sheran en imbin lukaftumbat detlot buligi weya dei garram langa det plein kantri gulum Sheran. Shafat det san blanga Edlai bin lukaftumbat detlot buligi langa detlot beli. Obil brom detlot Ishmeil pipul bin lukaftumbat detlot kemul. Jedeiya brom det pleis gulum Meranath bin lukaftumbat detlot dongki. Jeisis hubin brom detlot Heigrait pipul bin lukaftumbat detlot ship en gout.
King Deibid en detlot men hubin albumbat im
Wal King Deibid anggul Jonathan, imbin brabli klebawan en imbin sabi ebrijing. Im en Jehiyel det san blanga Hekmanai dubala bin boswan wekinmen blanga titjimbat detlot san blanga det king.
En Ahithafel imbin det speshalwan wekinmen blanga album det king, en Hushai brom det femili lain blanga Akait imbin det speshalwan fren blanga det king.
Bambai wen Ahithafel bin dai, Abaiyatha, en Jehoiyada det san blanga Benaiya bin speshalwan blanga album det king. Jowab bin det boswan lida blanga detlot amimob.
